user.title: ISP Modem LAN (experimental)
user.description: Choose the exact modem family. Claro has a verified manual restart button; Vivo has an experimental manual restart button whose result has not been confirmed on a live modem. Press only when an interruption is acceptable. Status may require credentials. Both observed login protocols use unencrypted HTTP: use only on a trusted management LAN. No automatic restarts.

error.invalid_host: Enter an IPv4 address without a URL or path
error.cannot_connect: Could not read the modem status. If it requires a login, enter the username and password.
error.credentials_required: Vivo requires a username and password
